plugins.catalog_notes: Curated first-choice recorder/transcription candidate. Upstream latest release checked: 2.6.1 (2026-11-25); Obsidian community listing showed about 2k downloads. Supports recording, transcription, optional LLM cleanup/summary and speaker labels where supported. Upstream declares desktop and mobile (iOS/Android), but all five manager platform statuses remain declared_unverified; installation stays blocked in the mobile manager until real device evidence is recorded. Minimum Obsidian version in upstream manifest: 1.14.4.
